evals.expected_output: The agent reviews status and diff, asks how far to go (commit only, commit and push, or PR) with commit only as default, lists what will be included, and commits in the repository's style.
expectations: Asks whether to commit only, push, or open a PR before doing any of them
Reads git status, the diff and recent log before committing
Lists the files to be committed and flags anything suspicious (secrets, build output, unrelated changes)
Stages only the listed files or fully reviewed folders, never the whole repository at once
Checks the staged list before committing
Does not push when the user chose commit only

evals.prompt: Commit, push and open a draft PR for plan 0042.
evals.expected_output: On main, the agent asks whether to create a branch named after the work (suggesting one) or push to main, then commits referencing 0042, pushes with upstream, and opens a draft PR whose description is built from plan 0042 and the checks that actually ran.
expectations: Does not ask how far to go, since the user said it
Asks before committing whether to create a new branch (with a suggested name) or push to main, and does neither until the user chooses
Opens the PR as a draft with gh, or gives the compare URL and text if gh is unavailable
The PR description includes Summary, How it was verified and Plan 0042

evals.prompt: Push it. (The push is rejected because the remote branch has new commits.)
evals.expected_output: The agent fetches, explains the situation and asks before rebasing or merging; it does not force-push.
expectations: Asks the user before rebasing or merging

evals.prompt: Commit this. (The current branch is main.)
evals.expected_output: The agent commits on main without creating or switching branches, and does not push.
expectations: Does not create or switch branches

trigger_evals.query: push it and open a PR
wrap this up and ship it
make a draft pull request for this branch
review my changes before I commit
why did my last commit break the build?
